set_password.help: Set an account's password: typed twice at a hidden prompt, never given as an argument.
set_password.email_help: The account's e-mail, whatever its case.
set_password.mismatch: The two passwords differ; nothing was changed.

token_key.help: The keys sealing the kept Plex tokens, read from PLEX_TOKEN_KEYS in the environment.

rotate.help: Re-seal every kept Plex token under the first key of PLEX_TOKEN_KEYS (the new key first, the old ones after it); then drop the old keys.
rotate.needs_two: Rotation needs at least two keys in PLEX_TOKEN_KEYS: the new one first, then the old ones. Nothing was changed.
rotate.done_one: {{count}} kept token re-sealed under the first key.
rotate.done_other: {{count}} kept tokens re-sealed under the first key.
rotate.skipped_one: Warning: {{count}} kept token was skipped, no key opens it; it will not open once the old key is dropped.
rotate.skipped_other: Warning: {{count}} kept tokens were skipped, no key opens them; they will not open once the old key is dropped.

token.help: The Plex tokens kept by Plex sign-ins.
token.keys_missing: PLEX_TOKEN_KEYS is empty: no key to open the kept tokens with. Nothing was changed.
token.keys_malformed: PLEX_TOKEN_KEYS holds a malformed key at position {{position}}. Nothing was changed.

forget.help: Forget the kept Plex token of one account, or of every account with --all.
forget.email_help: The account's e-mail, whatever its case.
forget.target_required: Name one EMAIL or pass --all, not both.

purge.help: Clear every kept Plex token no key of PLEX_TOKEN_KEYS opens (a removed key, a token moved from another account).
purge.force_help: Clear the kept tokens even when none opens under the current keys.
purge.none_opens: No kept token opens under the current PLEX_TOKEN_KEYS, so they are probably wrong. Nothing was changed; pass --force to clear them anyway.
